wording.citation: Juanchich, Sirota and Bonnefon, The polite wiggle-room effect in charity donation decisions, DOI 10.1002/bdm.2103
wording.source_type: Published rounded aggregate estimates, manually transcribed; not individual observations
wording.selection: All six donation wording contrasts in main Experiments 1, 2 and 3; Appendix D1 used as an internal consistency check. Experiment 3 contrasts apply to donation-first order, not both orders pooled.
wording.data_access: The paper's https://goo.gl/ffGH55 data link returned HTTP 404 on 2026-10-21; no raw-data refit performed.

history.citation: Muchnik, Aral and Taylor (2013), Social Influence Bias: A Randomized Experiment, DOI 10.1126/science.1240466
history.source_type: Published rounded proportions, page 649; no individual data or reconstructed counts
history.scope: Earlier displayed ratings of the same comment, followed by later viewers; not a test of an author's treatment across different future comments or private psychological memory
